definitions.explanation: To give money in exchange for goods or services.

examples.japanese: {料金|りょうきん}を{支払|しはら}う。
クレジットカードで{支払|しはら}う。

notes:
{支払|しはら}う is a godan verb meaning to pay, typically used in formal or business contexts.

TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive - takes を to mark what is being paid.

CONJUGATION (godan う-verb):
- {支払|しはら}わない (negative)
- {支払|しはら}います (polite)
- {支払|しはら}った (past)
- {支払|しはら}って (te-form)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {料金|りょうきん}を{支払|しはら}う: to pay the fee
- {税金|ぜいきん}を{支払|しはら}う: to pay taxes
- {家賃|やちん}を{支払|しはら}う: to pay rent
- {現金|げんきん}で{支払|しはら}う: to pay in cash
- クレジットカードで{支払|しはら}う: to pay by credit card

RELATED FORMS:
- {支払|しはら}い (noun): payment
- {支払|しはら}い{方法|ほうほう}: payment method
- {支払|しはら}い{期限|きげん}: payment deadline
- {支払|しはら}い{済|ず}み: paid (in full)

COMPARISON WITH {払|はら}う:
- {支払|しはら}う: more formal, used in business/official contexts
- {払|はら}う: general, everyday usage

NOTE:
{払|はら}う can also mean 'to brush off' or 'to sweep away,' but {支払|しはら}う is exclusively for monetary payment.
